Jess (CSM): FYI: OrbitEdge dedicated bring-up Friday 09:30 PT. Customer target: steady 600 RPS, short spikes to 2k for 20-40s. Need final quota confirmation, autoscale tuning, priming plan, and a 20-min SRE handoff. Renewal in 8 months, flagged if onboarding has >2 throttles.

Omar (SRE): Copy. Contracted reserved_gpus=10, burst allowance +15% when capacity free. I'll add a 24h slot-lock post-cutover and soft-throttle at 80% GPU mem. Share token histogram please.

Hana (Infra Eng): Sample: p50=62 tokens, p95=205, avg request ~305 tokens. Recommend slot_max_seq=512, min_slots=3, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s. Add model-fallback to quantized-lite if tail latency >600ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Avoid KMS rotate during run.

Dan (Solutions): Load plan: smoke 10m @60-90 RPS, soak 2h @600 RPS, spike script: 30s ramp ->2k, hold 30s, decay 40s. Use loadgen with token tracing. Command example:

./loadgen --url https://dedicated-us.redwood/api/generate --concurrency 200 --qps 600 --burst 2000 --burst-duration 30 --duration 7200 --headers 'x-customer-id:ORBITEDGE'

Hana (Infra Eng): Pre-warm KV cache with priming job ~30m before window. Example:

python prime.py --endpoint /prime --slots 6 --concurrency 30 --duration 1800 --prefix-dir ./samples

Jess (CSM): Action items: @Hana run priming EOD; @Omar set throttle & slot-lock AM; @Dan run smoke + soak during window; I'll host the handoff and invite billing + renewals. ops-bot set reminder.

ops-bot: reminder set: "OrbitEdge dedicated warmup" Fri 2024-04-12T16:30:00Z (09:30 PT). Post-run summary will be auto-attached here. :rocket:
